classification.difficultyReason: Each part gives a side ratio and a base segment in a nested right-triangle pair. The student must find the unknown side, work out the full base or the remaining segment, decide which triangle is the original and which the image, and form the ratio. This is the same demand as p40-q14, with no new insight beyond it.

content.prompt: Determine the scale factor for each pair of similar triangles.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
$OM$ is twice the length of $MK$.
Let $\triangle OMK$ be the original triangle.

answer.worked:
Corresponding sides have the same ratio, so $ON:NL=OM:MK=2:1$.
$$\begin{aligned}ON&=2\times12=24\text{ cm}\\OM&=24-3=21\text{ cm}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{ON}{OM}=\frac{24}{21}=\frac87.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt:
$GJ$ is three-quarters the length of $FG$.
Let $\triangle FGJ$ be the original triangle.

answer.worked:
Corresponding sides have the same ratio, so $GJ:FG=3:4$.
$$\begin{aligned}FG&=\frac43\times9=12\text{ cm}\\FH&=12-4=8\text{ cm}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{FH}{FG}=\frac{8}{12}=\frac23.\end{aligned}$$
